newsitem.title: AZERBAIJAN: Mobil, Ramco, Total to form Caspian oil consortium.
newsitem.headline: Mobil, Ramco, Total to form Caspian oil consortium.

text.p: Aberdeen-based Ramco Energy Plc, U.S. Mobil and Total of France said on Tuesday that they would form a consortium called MRT to develop oil reserves in the Azeri sector of the Caspian Sea.

Ramco President Stephen Remp told journalists before meeting Azeri President Heydar Aliyev behind closed doors that drilling on unidentified, shallow-water structures in the southern part of the sector could begin in 1998 after three-dimensional seismic surveys were completed.
Officials gave no details on how much the group would invest and said the project was still in a preliminary stage.

Total spokeswoman Claire Baconnet said from Paris that Mobil and Total could each take a 40 percent stake in the consortium, with Ramco having the remaining 20 percent, but that stakes had not yet been finalised.
